```{=html}
<style>
.cvx {
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 4rem) clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2rem) clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
}

/* ── Identity header ───────────────────────────── */
.cvx-id {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--white);
  padding: clamp(1.35rem, 3vw, 2.1rem);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.05);
}
.cvx-id-top {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 1.5rem 2rem;
  align-items: start;
}
.cvx-kicker {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin: 0;
}
.cvx-name {
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.2vw, 3rem);
  line-height: 1.02;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin: 0.35rem 0 0.4rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.cvx-roleline {
  margin: 0 0 0.7rem;
  color: var(--terra);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}
.cvx-claim {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 62ch;
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}
.cvx-contact {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-top: 1.15rem;
}
.cvx-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  align-items: stretch;
}
.cvx-actions .btn-solid,
.cvx-actions .btn-ghost { justify-content: center; }

.cvx-proof {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(185px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.85rem clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
  margin-top: 1.4rem;
  padding-top: 1.15rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.cvx-proof div { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.45rem; }
.cvx-proof b {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.cvx-proof span { font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--muted); }

/* ── Two-column body ───────────────────────────── */
.cvx-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.72fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.75rem);
  align-items: start;
  margin-top: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
}

.cvx-spine-h {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 2.4vw, 1.65rem);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin: 0 0 1.15rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.6rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.cvx-spine-h + .cvx-role { padding-top: 0; }

.cvx-role { padding: 1.4rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.cvx-role:first-of-type { border-top: none; }
.cvx-role-head {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
}
.cvx-yr {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.71rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--terra);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.cvx-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.06rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.3; }
.cvx-org { width: 100%; margin: 0.2rem 0 0; font-size: 0.81rem; color: var(--muted); }
.cvx-lead { margin: 0.65rem 0 0.15rem; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text); }
.cvx-role ul { margin: 0.55rem 0 0; padding-left: 1.05rem; }
.cvx-role li { margin-bottom: 0.45rem; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.58; color: var(--text); }
.cvx-role li:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.cvx-role a { color: var(--terra); text-underline-offset: 2px; }

.cvx-earlier { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; margin-top: 0.3rem; }
.cvx-earlier-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 6rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 0.2rem 1rem;
}
.cvx-earlier-item p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--text); }
.cvx-earlier-item strong { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); }
.cvx-earlier-item em { font-style: normal; color: var(--muted); }

/* ── Rail ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.cvx-rail > .cvx-railsec { margin-bottom: 2.15rem; }
.cvx-rail > .cvx-railsec:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.cvx-rail-h {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin: 0 0 0.9rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.cvx-comp { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.95rem; }
.cvx-comp h4 { margin: 0 0 0.4rem; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.35; }
.cvx-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem; }
.cvx-tags span {
  font-size: 0.67rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text);
  background: transparent;
}
.cvx-block { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.cvx-block:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.cvx-block h4 { margin: 0.15rem 0 0.15rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); }
.cvx-block p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.79rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); }
.cvx-block .cvx-yr { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.1rem; }
.cvx-pubs { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.05rem; }
.cvx-pubs li { margin-bottom: 0.6rem; font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text); }
.cvx-pubs li:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.cvx-note { margin: 0; font-size: 0.79rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--muted); }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .cvx-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2.5rem; }
  .cvx-id-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cvx-actions { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .cvx-earlier-item { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .cvx-role, .cvx-rail > .cvx-railsec {
    animation: cvxRise 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
  }
  .cvx-role:nth-of-type(2) { animation-delay: 0.06s; }
  .cvx-role:nth-of-type(3) { animation-delay: 0.12s; }
  .cvx-rail > .cvx-railsec:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.06s; }
  .cvx-rail > .cvx-railsec:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.12s; }
  .cvx-rail > .cvx-railsec:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.18s; }
  .cvx-rail > .cvx-railsec:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.24s; }
  @keyframes cvxRise {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  }
}

@media print {
  .cvx-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; }
  .cvx-actions, .cvx-id { box-shadow: none; }
  .cvx-actions { display: none; }
  .cvx-role, .cvx-rail > .cvx-railsec { animation: none; break-inside: avoid; }
}
</style>
```
